# Green Continent Tours

> Krakow-based travel agency, tour operator and destination management company (DMC) organising private tours, group trips, family holidays, halal-friendly travel, airport transfers and tailor-made itineraries across Poland and Central Europe. Tours in English, Polish, Arabic, Spanish and German.

Contact: +48 537 482 798 (phone / WhatsApp) · info@greencontinenttours.com · Nowohucka 46, 31-580 Kraków, Poland
